source_results.outcome_status: opened; this is a planned cross-repository replication of the previously frozen ALG-007 rules, not confirmation

embedding.artifact_policy: raw vectors remain ignored; commit identities, vector digest, aggregate summaries, and selection digests

research_contract.target: Test whether the two frozen ALG-007 semantic coreset rules transfer across repository-local Origins without fitting outcomes.
research_contract.primary_baseline: all eligible historical Tasks from the same repository
research_contract.primary_loss: mean across the three frozen public Agents of absolute selected-history versus future-cohort pass-rate error
non_solutions: choosing another semantic window after seeing these outcomes
using Agent outcomes or future text in Selection
mixing repositories into one semantic candidate pool
treating semantic centroid distance as outcome evidence
promoting a Runner default from opened development outcomes

candidates.rule: greedy kernel-mean coreset plus at most 20 improving one-for-one swaps toward the latest-15 text centroid
greedy facility location covering the latest-15 text embeddings

diagnostics.semantic_alignment: selected-versus-future centroid cosine distance is descriptive only

requirements: wide macro-repository difference is at most -0.01
at least five of seven repositories have negative difference
every wide leave-one-repository-out summary is negative
candidate is better than at least 75 percent of equal-budget random draws
nomination_rule.effect: At most one candidate, ordered by wide macro loss then selector_id, is frozen for independent validation. Production promotion remains forbidden.

authority.allowed_runtime: local CPU using the already-cached pinned model snapshot
authority.implementation_scope: one direct experiment-layer embedding extractor and one direct semantic replay
